title: Google Cloud Overview
description: The Google Cloud services ObserveCraft collects from Cloud Monitoring: Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and load balancing.

definition.content: A starting point for the Google Cloud services ObserveCraft collects from Cloud Monitoring. Add service accounts in [Integrations → Google Cloud](/integrations/gcp); every chart filters by project.
Database instances: connections, CPU, memory and disk.
Clusters: node utilization of allocatable resources, container memory and restarts.
Serverless: requests and instances of Cloud Run services, executions of functions.
External HTTP(S) load balancers: requests and bytes.
